Route

The driving route we took through the country using Alex’s road maps. Maybe a section of scary routes at the end with elevation.

June 17th: Arrival in Iceland

  1. Landed at the Keflavík International Airport
  2. Drove to Reykjavik:
    • Walked around the city
    • It was the National Day of Iceland!

June 18th: Landmarks in southwest Iceland

  1. Thingvellir is the site of Iceland’s parliament from the 10th the 18th century
  2. Geysir, a.k.a. The Great Geysir, is a hot spring and geothermal area
  3. Gullfoss, a.k.a. Golden Falls, is a huge two-tiered waterfall

June 19th: Back to Reykjavik

  1. More activities in the capital:
    • National Museum of Iceland
    • Grotta lighthouse
    • Nautholsvik beach
    • Some interesting stores we missed on day 1

June 20th: First day towards the Westfjords

  1. Barnafoss and Hraunfossar waterfalls
  2. Tour of the Víðgelmir lava tube cave
  3. Arrival at Gil Guesthouse for the night

June 21st: Beaches and Birds

  1. Rauðisandur, the red sand beaches
  2. Látrabjarg, the westernmost point in Iceland
  3. Arrival at Harbour Inn Guesthouse for the night

June 22nd: A day in Ísafjörður

  1. Dynjandi waterfall
  2. Arrival in Ísafjörður, the largest settlement of the Westfjords (pop. 2744)
    • Bike tour around the avalanche walls of Ísafjörður
  3. Arrival at Einarshús Guesthouse for the night

June 23th: Along the eastern Westfjords

  1. Whale-watching in Ísafjarðardjúp and Jökulfirðir
  2. Sheep farming Museum south of Holmavik
  3. Museum of Witchcraft and Sorcery in Holmavik
  4. Arrival at Dalahótel for the night, which included a natural hot spring

June 24th: Happy birthday, Alex! A special day to celebrate

  1. Horse riding at Dalahestar
  2. Drive back down past Reykjavik to some geothermal sites around the Reykjanes
  3. Arrival at Northern Light Inn for a birthday dinner and an evening at the Blue Lagoon spa

June 25th: More of the Reykjanes

  1. Very long hike along Fagradalsfjall volcano
  2. Visit to the Bridge Between Continents, which spans a fissure between the Eurasian and North American tectonic plates
  3. Drive back to Reykjavik for an evening at the Sky Lagoon spa

June 26th: Goodbye Iceland!

  1. Drive back to Keflavík International Airport to catch our early flight home

That’s all!
